notes:
Snapshot: mid-market SaaS KB vendor building RAG for customers (help center + knowledge base + product docs). Looking for hosted API with high QPS and a rerank stage.

Lead: CTO (Lena Ortiz) very cost-conscious; Head of Search (Akash Mehta) owns technical evaluation. AE Jordan P took over from inbound SDR. SE Riley on POC.

Key requirements (verbosish notes):
- Index scale: ~8–12M passages (documents split into ~500k–1M chunks depending on chunking).
- QPS: expected peak 800–1,200 qps at launch (multi-tenant traffic).
- Workload: embed-ingest (batch nightly + incremental streaming), nearest-neighbor retrieval, neural reranker cross-encoder on topK=50–100.
- Latency targets: embedding lookup + retrieval + rerank end-to-end P95 < 120ms (goal), comfortable P95 < 200ms fallback. 50ms token gen not required (no chat heavy).
- Cost sensitivity: target total cost per query (including retrieval + rerank) <= $0.0005; currently benchmarking at $0.0012 on incumbent.
- Model prefs: open-source bi-encoders for vector index (sBERT-family or similar) for embeddings; reranker: lightweight cross-encoder (quantized 8-bit) or Redwood-verified re-rank model; fallback BM25/rule-based scoring when GPU capacity constrained.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to CPU-based hybrid search in case of GPU pressure; prefer model-variant routing by latency/cost policy.
- Observability: token-level cost per route, per-model latency traces, per-query rerank deltas (score deltas), regression alerts tied to eval prompt sets.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs, retention policy controls, ability to restrict EU customer docs to EU region.

Quotes & snippets:
- "If we can't get cost per query below ~$0.0005 with the reranker in the loop we won't ship this way." — Lena (CTO).
- "Need stable P95 numbers at scale, not synthetic microbenchmarks." — Akash (Head of Search).

POC scope so far:
- Redwood hosted API POC: ingest 2M sample passages, run 2-week high-QPS synthetic replay (peak 1k qps) + production shadow for a subset of customers.
- Measure: embedding latency, retrieval recall@10, rerank recall@5, end-to-end P95 latency, cost per 1k queries.

Docs & links referenced during calls: pricing deck, security FAQ, POC playbook (drive links above). Meeting transcripts attached (Fireflies ids).

Signals: product team likes Redwood's routing + fallback features; worried about sustained cost with cross-encoder reranker. Prior vendor is managed vector DB + hosted mini-re-rank; they reported jitter at scale.

Notes on commercial: prefer annual commit if performance & residency checks pass. Initial ask: guidance on batching, KV cache suggestions, model quantization profiles.

Short-term next: run Redwood batch/stream ingest test, generate sample perf report (Riley), schedule executive Q&A 3/20.
